operations.raw_source_derivation: close and quote_turnover are derived per r1_source_precedence_freeze.json daily_close/quote_turnover rules from canonical unique Bybit historical trades for the UTC day
operations.timing_rule: decision at UTC daily close t; only trailing (t-89..t) close days and (t-29..t) turnover days already materialized may be consulted
operations.missingness_behavior: a missing required trailing day makes the symbol ineligible at t (fails the 90/30 finite-day rule); it is never imputed or forward-filled
operations.known_open_issue: r1_semantic_issue_ledger.json:PIT-DAILY-BREADTH-UNMATERIALIZED (BLOCKING_AMBIGUITY) -- whether breadth>=10 actually holds on >=90% of candidate dates over the full acquired population is UNPROVEN; this is a population-materialization proof deferred to the acquisition/reservoir gaps, not a gap in this schema

operations.raw_source_derivation: last qualifying trade by UTC event timestamp, then immutable trade identity (r1_source_precedence_freeze.json:daily_close)
operations.timing_rule: score at t requires both close[t] and close[t-lookback] finite; lookback = 30d or 90d
operations.missingness_behavior: no score exists before its complete lookback; a missing endpoint close makes the score non-finite and the name is excluded from ranking that day only (does not change universe membership)

required_information: every settled funding event dated in the inclusive UTC daily window ending t (1 day for 24h, 7 days for 7d)
operations.raw_source_derivation: official realized Bybit funding-history observation only; never predicted_funding_rate, never a projection from current fundingInterval (r1_source_precedence_freeze.json:funding_settlement, funding_timestamp)
operations.timing_rule: score requires every daily cell in the window to be present; window is (t-lookback, t] inclusive of settlement timestamps
operations.missingness_behavior: any missing settled event in the required window makes the score unavailable that day; no imputed cashflow, reported as missing (matches downstream funding-economics rule in the same closure spec)

required_information: settlement_timestamp carried by the realized funding observation
instrument_instance identity to prevent cross-lineage assignment
operations.raw_source_derivation: GET /v5/market/funding/history?category=linear&symbol=<symbol>, segmented in inclusive UTC ranges of at most 60 days, recursively bisected below the 200-row page cap (qntylab/r1_input_bom.py:funding_request_rule)
operations.timing_rule: conflict_rule (r1_source_precedence_freeze.json): non-identical duplicate funding settlements at the same timestamp are fail-closed, never silently merged
operations.missingness_behavior: assignment_state=UNASSIGNED_AMBIGUOUS when instrument identity is IDENTITY_AMBIGUOUS (r1_semantic_issue_ledger.json:identity_reuse_candidates); such events are not attributed to either candidate lineage

operations.raw_source_derivation: timestamped official lifecycle/delisting evidence (GRADE_A), qualified contemporaneous capture (GRADE_B), last observation/disappearance only (GRADE_C), or contradictory (GRADE_X) -- per r1_lifecycle_contract.json:evidence_grades
operations.timing_rule: cutoff_utc=2026-06-30T23:59:59Z; no event/observation timestamp after cutoff may be consulted
operations.missingness_behavior: GRADE_C/GRADE_X exposed terminal is BLOCKED_BY_DATA_INTEGRITY, not silently resolved; ambiguous-unexposed instances are removed after their last verified tradable state (r1_lifecycle_contract.json:terminal_policy)

operations.raw_source_derivation: timestamped exchange/vendor incident or preserved observation sequence; fallback UNKNOWN (r1_source_precedence_freeze.json:gap_classification)
operations.missingness_behavior: archive/API absence is never turned into a terminal event; a leg earns zero price return and reports a forced-close flag rather than bridging a gap (sprint_v2_pre_outcome_semantic_closure_001.json:daily execution and gaps)

required_information: count of PIT-eligible symbols on date t
operations.raw_source_derivation: derived count, not a raw field; requires no field beyond the PIT universe selection inputs above
operations.missingness_behavior: n<10 eligible names on date t means no book forms that day (n>=10 and n>=2k required per sprint_v2_pre_outcome_semantic_closure_001.json:ranking and buckets); this is a reporting outcome of the gate, not a missing-field condition

operations.raw_source_derivation: same daily_close derivation as above; no additional raw market field is required for turnover-based cost application (cost_bps applied to abs(weight_new-weight_old), which needs no market field at all)
operations.timing_rule: a leg earns a price return only when both closes are finite and adjacent ledger dates are consecutive UTC calendar dates
operations.missingness_behavior: otherwise it earns zero price return and its forced-close flag is reported; no gap return is bridged
